opinions.text:
On petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia Circuit. The order entered November 30, 1953, denying certiorari, 346 U. S. 896, is vacated and the petition for writ of certiorari is granted.

Mr. Justice Black dissents.
